summary: First iteration end-to-end test of Manifest. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed covering meta, auth (signup/login/me/duplicate/wrong-pw/no-token), usage bump (+verify), payments checkout, payments status (no-crash), webhook bad-signature 400, account deletion. Frontend: landing renders hero/pricing/footer; /signup, /login, /app, /account, /privacy, /terms, /auth/callback all load; /app & /account redirect unauthenticated to /login; AuthCallback without session_id redirects to /login; signup→/app flow works with plan-pill-free; dropzone + file-input accept sample export; manifest section renders with selection note; pack button enables after group selection; privacy guarantee verified — during a full pack flow ONLY `POST /api/usage/bump` with `{conversations:1,projects:1}` was sent, no SECRET_TITLE_TOKEN_XYZ / SECRET_BODY_TOKEN_ABC anywhere in network traffic; UpgradeModal opens via unlock-link and Buy button POSTs /api/payments/checkout; Account page shows email/plan/usage and delete-confirm flow.

issues: After file upload group checkboxes default to UNCHECKED so the selection-note always starts at '0 conversations selected' and the Pack button stays disabled until the user manually ticks a group. This is technically the spec ('Untick anything you don't want to bring along'), but the wording implies items are pre-selected. Consider defaulting groups to checked=true, or updating the helper text. Not a bug; UX note.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:267 — success_url uses `?upgraded=1&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}` literal placeholder; verify StripeCheckout helper interpolates this correctly (Stripe expects `{CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}` token but emergentintegrations may require a different convention). Could break the post-payment polling on /app.

server.py:339 — webhook uses a fresh StripeCheckout(webhook_url='') for verification. If the lib requires the same webhook_url that was used during session creation for signature verification, this could silently reject valid signatures. Behavior with a bad signature correctly returns 400 in our test, but real webhook verification path is untested.

AppTool.jsx — usage/bump is awaited inside a try/catch that swallows errors silently; if the API is down, the user sees a successful pack but the counters never increment. Consider surfacing a soft warning.
AppTool.jsx:59 — useEffect dep array disables exhaustive-deps; if user lands on /app with multiple URL params changes it won't re-poll. Acceptable for first iteration.
UpgradeModal.jsx — no max retry / loading-spinner reset if window.location.href fails (e.g., when Stripe URL is invalid). The `loading=true` stays stuck. Minor.
test_credentials: Random emails @manifestqa.io created on the fly via /api/auth/signup; one test user qa2_*@manifestqa.io was left in the DB after the privacy/pack test. Pre-seeded testers in /app/memory/test_credentials.md were not used.
seed_data_creation: Created /app/_ref/sample_export.json (1 conversation 'SECRET_TITLE_TOKEN_XYZ' with body 'SECRET_BODY_TOKEN_ABC') as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints pass via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (use `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`). Frontend flows confirmed including the critical privacy guarantee. Real Stripe payment was NOT completed; only checkout-session creation was exercised. Google OAuth flow not tested (requires real Google identity). The Stripe success_url-placeholder caveat is the only thing that may need a manual end-to-end payment test before production.
